name: Format on Save
description: Formats a file when it is saved, where the project configures a formatter (.clang-format, ruff or black in pyproject.toml, .prettierrc, Cargo.toml, .editorconfig for shfmt; gofmt always), as one undo step. Needs the formatter itself; written in Go, built once with go.

commands.name: Format: Turn Format on Save Off or On for This Project
